title: Jesus... Appa Went Diwali Shopping Alone
topic: he ordered everything online instead of walking the bazaar with his Appa like they used to, and realised it too late

bible.text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... Appa wanted us to shop for Diwali together. Why did I order everything online instead? 🛒

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: He walked the bazaar alone. I was saving time.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You bought the lamps. You skipped the reason he wanted the walk.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It's just shopping, right? The house looks festive anyway.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: To him it wasn't shopping. It was the once-a-year walk with his son.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The festival isn't the things. It's who you spend the day with.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What family errand do you keep postponing? 👇
